#WATCH | 🚀 ‘India’s First’: ISRO Successfully Launches EOS-05 Into Orbit

Sriharikota: ISRO Chief V Narayanan announces the successful and precise injection of EOS-05, India’s first-ever imaging satellite from geosynchronous orbit, aboard the GSLV-F17.

Positioned around 36,000 km above Earth, EOS-05 is designed to provide continuous, near-real-time imaging of India and surrounding regions, strengthening earth observation and strategic monitoring capabilities. The 2,367-kg satellite was placed into a sub-geosynchronous transfer orbit and will subsequently be raised to its operational orbit.

#WATCH 🎥 | 🚨 Nine Days After Deadly Floods, Workers Rescued Alive From Trishuli 3A Tunnel in Nepal

Rescue workers pulled a person alive from a tunnel at the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Project on Friday, nine days after devastating flash floods and landslides swept through Nepal’s Trishuli River valley on August 26. 

The breakthrough has raised hopes of finding more survivors. Two workers — Sanjay Sah and Kabir Maharjan — have now been rescued alive, while hundreds of workers remain missing across hydropower projects affected by the disaster.
